title: Ya Baqiatullah
body:
ya baqiatullah ya hujatullah
ya ibne hyder ya ibna zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
aaiye zulm hadh se siwa ho gaya
be-sabab momim qatl rawan hogaya
aap ka ishq wajhe saza ho gaya
ab hamare labon par hai har dam sada
ya baqiatullah….
<<DIVIDER>>
tez tar hogayi kufr ki aandhiyan
kufr ki zad pe hai haq ke ab pasban
ab to aajiye ay shahe ins o jaan
humko dije amaa mazhare kibriya
ya baqiatullah….
<<DIVIDER>>
ab na mehfooz masjid na mehrab hai
kufr o zulmat ka har simt sailaab hai
har muhib dard e furqat se betaab hai
maangte hai ye ro ro ke momin dua
ya baqiatullah….
<<DIVIDER>>
aaiye aaiye ab khuda ke liye
binte zehra ke sar ki rida ke liye
inteqam e shahe karbala ke liye
dijiye dushmane deen e haq ko saza
ya baqiatullah….
<<DIVIDER>>
bazme kaunain may hukmaran aap hai
dhoop hai ye jahan sayeban aap hai
marziye rab wahan hai jahan aap hai
aap ki zaat hai hujjate kibriya
ya baqiatullah….
<<DIVIDER>>
barishe noor dunya may barsaiye
rehm farmaiye rehm farmaiye
ya imame zaman jald aajiye
aap bhi misle hyder hai mushkil kusha
ya baqiatullah….
<<DIVIDER>>
waasta tumko sajjad e maghmoom ka
waasta hai tumhe shahe mazloom ka
waasta hai tumhe halqe masoom ka
apne lashkar se maula tu humko mila
ya baqiatullah….
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt par hukmarani hai maula teri
saltanat javedani hai maula teri
khuld to raajdhani hai maula teri
hai riyaz ek adna sa naukar tera
ya baqiatullah….
